name: Tool — Web search (OpenAI built-in)
summary: OpenAI's built-in web_search_preview tool called directly through the Responses API with a BYOM-prefixed model — no Bing connection required.
description: Tests whether the built-in Responses `web_search_preview` tool works when the model is BYOM-routed via APIM. Distinct from tool-web-search which uses Foundry's BingGroundingTool wrapper.
notes:
BYOM is not confirmed for OpenAI-native `web_search` forwarding.

Requires no `BING_CONNECTION_ID`. Result depends on whether the Foundry APIM connection forwards the OpenAI-native `web_search` tool call through to OpenAI's backend.
